### How this stays current

Everything on this dashboard comes from one file: **`assets/tasks.js`**. Mark a task `"done"`, add a note, or change a date there, then re-render (`quarto render` or `quarto preview`). The urgency colors — 🔴 overdue, 🟠 due within 7 days — are computed live in your browser against today's date, so they're accurate even between renders.
